title: Set 编码切换：intset 与 hashtable
expected_output:
int set    -> intset
mixed set  -> hashtable
large ints -> hashtable
code:
SET_MAX_ENTRIES = 512

def set_encoding(items):
    n = len(items)
    if n == 0:
        return "intset"
    if all(isinstance(x, int) and -(2 ** 63) <= x < 2 ** 63 for x in items) and n <= SET_MAX_ENTRIES:
        return "intset"
    return "hashtable"

ints = list(range(10))
mixed = [1, 2, "x"]
big = list(range(600))
print("int set    ->", set_encoding(ints))
print("mixed set  ->", set_encoding(mixed))
print("large ints ->", set_encoding(big))
